Abans Finance PLC · Company Profile02
About Us

A trusted name, built over two decades

Abans Finance PLC is a Sri Lanka based non-bank financial institution and a subsidiary of the diversified Abans Group, a household name for over five decades.

We began operations in April 2006, obtained our Finance Company licence in August 2007, and listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange in 2011. We operate under the supervision of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

Our customers are served through 23 branches and the Abans Group's island-wide network of over 400 outlets.

Our Journey

Milestones of trust & growth

2006
The Beginning

Began operations as a Registered Finance Leasing Establishment, with a team of about 10 people.

2007
Licensed

Obtained the Finance Company licence from the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

2011
Publicly Listed

Listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange.

2025
Full Branches

All customer centres became fully operational branches.

2026
Record Year

Balance sheet over Rs. 20 Bn and first PBT above Rs. 1 Bn. Launched our first listed debenture, and gold loan portfolio passed Rs. 1 Bn.

2026
Recognised

First runner-up, Best Management Practices Company Awards 2026 (CPM).
